system.description:
Knowledge venerates understanding obtained through study, observation and honest inquiry. It differs from Revelation because knowledge need not arrive through prophecy or supernatural insight: a carefully maintained ledger, a dissected specimen and a corrected historical record may all be equally sacred. Its symbols include an open book beneath an eye, a lamp beside a stack of tablets and a key laid across a written page.

Edicts: Seek accurate knowledge. Preserve useful records. Investigate before reaching conclusions. Teach knowledge responsibly. Correct dangerous falsehoods. Distinguish evidence from belief or assumption.

Anathema: Knowingly falsify scholarship. Destroy unique knowledge merely to monopolise it. Suppress useful truth solely to protect your own status. Deliberately teach something you know to be false. Refuse to correct a dangerous error for which you are responsible.

Suggested Ethics: Adaptability, Ambition, Prudence

Class Skill: Arcana

Specialist Spells: Guiding Stone (1), Revelation Divine (1), Seer's Vision (1), Truthful Words (1), Revealing Glance (7), Unity (7), Veiled Secret (7), Vigilant Eye (7)

Bonus Spells: Deific Knowing (2); Augury (4); Divine Vision (8); Commune (10)

Favoured Weapon: Club

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 7. Add it from the sheet's Divine Aspect slot: the class skill and favoured weapon apply, the bonus spells arrive at their levels, and Use chooses the specialist spell (PP 1 for a Grimward or Cleric).
